name: CI sccache hit floor — poweredge-xubuntu 5-minute hit ratio below 0.5 over 4 h
description: Fires when AVG(livespec.ci_cache.sccache.hit_ratio_5m) for host.name=poweredge-xubuntu over the trailing 4 h (Honeycomb's maximum trigger window) is below 0.5, evaluated hourly. The gauge is hits/(hits+misses) of the redis keyspace per 5-minute tick, emitted ONLY when there was traffic, so an idle pool cannot fire this; a sustained low ratio under real traffic means the compilation cache rotted: a toolchain bump not yet rebuilt, a redis restart before the next populate, or jobs keyed away from the populator's entries (research/006 Defect 2: any CARGO_* env var). HOST-side floor; the per-repo, canary-excluding floor from job spans is livespec-dev-tooling-mlg5sf's. Runbook: ssh poweredge-xubuntu; sudo kubectl -n ci-sccache exec deploy/sccache-redis -- redis-cli INFO stats | grep keyspace; sudo kubectl -n ci-warm-cache logs job/<latest> | grep sccache. Emitter: ci-runner/observability/ci-cache-gauges.sh. livespec-dev-tooling-gjqw2i, plan ci-runner-cache-tiers research/003.
